# Sonaloop

> Sonaloop is an MCP server for customer-persona simulation, councils, and design-research
> synthesis. The host agent authors all text; Sonaloop gathers context, validates and
> persists — no server-side text-LLM calls. This file indexes the canonical documentation
> in agent-friendly raw markdown.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/getting-started.md): one-sentence uvx install, MCP registration, sonaloop info diagnostics, first project
- [Example projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/examples.md): shipped demo studies — list/load/remove, idempotent loading
- [Job → Framework → Format taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/job-framework-format.md): the three-layer source-of-truth taxonomy + the A/B test, pricing and ideation run protocols + the Adding-a-Job recipe
- [Result schemas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/result-schemas.md): domain-neutral output contracts for Jobs and methodologies, evidence policy, live-required interruption seam
- [Frameworks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/frameworks.md): methodology frameworks a run can follow
- [Grounding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/grounding.md): evidence grounding and provenance
- [Cohort Integrity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/cohort-integrity.md): server-owned Reaction Test gate for independent persona depth/provenance, framed-hypothesis leakage, countervoices, remediation and explicit report limitations
- [Artifact inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/artifact-inventory.md): references vs assets vs flows vs sessions, and the artifact naming trap
- [Calibration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/calibration.md): prediction calibration and Brier scoring
- [Opt-in aggregation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/opt-in-aggregation-design.md): sentiment/coverage aggregation model
- [The live inspector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/live-inspector.md): navigation (4-item sidebar, archive-filtered current-job and run discovery, archived-job exact-link evidence access, Library browser, row slide-overs, run chip), event bus, SSE /api/events, activity feed, runs panel
- [Reliable job creation and continuation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/reliable-runs.md): frontdoor-only Cloud creation, immutable authenticated creator labels plus privacy-safe first-ingress `via …` connector attribution, audited owner-attested exact legacy corrections, weak-model-safe unfinished-job discovery and continuation, resumable single-report handoff, URL-only `needs_setup` remediation, explicit multi-screen capture review, dispatch-bound screen delivery receipts, bounded manifest observations, real candidate-backed cohort selection, logical-request deduplication, single-active-run ownership, Reaction Test integrity gates and engine-owned completion
- [Web editing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/web-editing.md): the inspector's write boundary — structural edits vs host-authored text
- [Keyboard, palette & tour](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/keyboard.md): shortcuts (j/k/Enter/o/Esc row + slide-over navigation), the command palette, the local opt-in product tour and shared-Cloud default
- [Feedback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/feedback.md): in-app feedback, /feedback inbox, CLI, SONALOOP_FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK
- [Cloud workspaces and customer access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/cloud-workspaces.md): tenant isolation, OIDC email/password identity, exact-email invitations, no-charge workspace provisioning and customer-facing tour policy
- [Cloud execution audit and PostHog observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/cloud-observability.md): batched, bounded and append-only tenant/RLS-bound Remote-MCP request lifecycle (`received` through response/disconnect/error), privacy-safe `initialize.clientInfo` connector-family binding and immutable first-ingress Job projection, authenticated HMAC-only `sonaloop_artifact_viewed` with structural report state and optional creator-match Boolean, closed tool/method labels, PostHog `sonaloop_mcp_request_phase` plus `$mcp_tool_call`/`$ai_span`, closed cohort outcomes, W3C correlation, per-attempt hosted `$ai_generation`, HMAC rotation, mixed legacy-aware local replay boundary and smoke test
- [Secure remote screenshots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/remote-screenshot-admission.md): direct-byte Remote-MCP admission, image and external scanner gates, tenant/run idempotency, immutable flow manifests and exact Product Understanding coverage
- [Cloud GitHub automations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/cloud-github-automations.md): GitHub App setup, webhook events, reaction-test flow, result schemas and writeback targets
- [Embeddings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/embeddings.md): semantic memory recall setup
- [Persona catalog & pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/catalog.md): catalog_search/recommend/pull MCP tools + the shared pagination convention
- [Lifecycle hooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/lifecycle-hooks.md): events, subscriptions, and the event bus behind the live inspector
- [Substrate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/substrate.md): queryable backend substrate for extensions
- [Project assets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/project-assets.md): attaching asset evidence
- [Flow walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/flow-walkthrough.md): live walkthrough mechanics
- [Live walkthrough safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/live-walkthrough-safety.md): safety constraints for live actuation
- [Selective live actuation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/selective-live-actuation.md): live prototype testing
